title: Grateful Dead Live at San Antonio Civic Auditorium on 1971-11-12

ai_review.summary: Fair mix with noticeable drop‑outs; a solid early‑70s show that's short, missing Pigpen and suffers from an over‑edited The Other One.
ai_review.review: The performance captures a classic early‑70s Dead vibe but is hampered by frequent audio drop‑offs and an oddly chopped The Other One. While the mix sounds good when present, the recording's inconsistencies keep it from being a five‑star experience, especially with Pigpen absent.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review rating of 3 stars; comments note both decent mix and significant recording issues, leading to a balanced middle rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is good when audible but many drop‑offs interrupt the set; editing splits The Other One into four separate tracks, affecting continuity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shorter than typical shows of this era; lacks Pigpen and feels truncated.
